senses.gloss:
r. 1st cl. (दवति)
To go, to move.
(दुनोति) r. 5th cl. (ओ, टु) ओटुटु
1 To be in pain, to burn morally or figuratively.
2 To cause pain, anxiety, &c.
3 To burn, to heat.

(ओ, ङ) ओदूङ् r. 4th cl. (दूयते)
1 To suffer or be consumed with pain.
2 To inflict pain or anxiety.

f. (दूः)
Pain, distress.
E.
दू, and क्विप् aff.
